# moshlabs Provider

Mosh Labs system-context primitives (platform/account/environment/service scoping) as native Terraform data sources instead of nested modules.

The provider takes no configuration.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Copyright 2026 Mosh Labs
# SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0

terraform {
  required_providers {
    moshlabs = {
      source  = "moshlabsdotnet/moshlabs"
      version = "~> 1.0"
    }
  }
}

# The provider takes no configuration.
provider "moshlabs" {}
```
